q: Reading records as variables rather than as background primarily means using them to:
choices: A. Establish the client's eligibility for funded services
B. Summarize the referral concern for the written report
C. Satisfy the documentation requirements of the funder
D. Shape when the assessment runs and what it includes

q: Bloom et al. (2011) found that trial-based functional analysis, relative to standard functional analysis, required:
choices: A. Identical time but fewer trained observers
B. Less time only for escape-maintained behavior
C. Slightly more total assessment time
D. Substantially less total assessment time

q: Two stimuli produce equal responding on a fixed-ratio 1 schedule but diverge sharply under progressive-ratio requirements. This suggests they:
choices: A. Were incorrectly identified by the preference assessment
B. Differ in strength, which matters for high-effort tasks
C. Should both be removed from the reinforcer pool
D. Are equally effective across all instructional contexts
